name: Newsletters » Marketing » Apple Private Relay
comments: Priority lowered to 500 (catch-all convention, see the bulk Deleted-Messages rules) so sender-specific rules that also match on @privaterelay.appleid.com (Zero, Golfshot, Thortful, Mailbuttler, Contacts+, Loom, ASOS, Receipts, Vue, Medium, SeatFrog, Taco Bell, Nextdoor) win first-match and this only catches unrecognized Hide My Email senders.
